scope: First narrow cosmic-ray propagation domain: the stable secondary-to-primary ratio B/C (from C and O) in a weighted-slab (leaky-box) model and in a 1D diffusion-halo model with a thin disc and no convection, with the closed forms derived and checked in SymPy, their equivalence lambda_esc = n_H m_H h v L / D (so the ratio constrains only D0/L), a benchmark against the profile's own numerical solutions (slab ODEs averaged over the path-length distribution; finite-thickness disc solved exactly and by finite volumes), a theory-spec with degenerate_directions [D0/L], and a prediction callable at any parameter point for grids. Cross-section sets are inputs and model alternatives; the shipped sets and transport values are ILLUSTRATIVE.
exclusions: Convection, reacceleration, energy losses, radioactive decay and unstable secondaries (10Be clocks)
Energy-dependent or published cross-section parametrizations; ghost-nucleus networks and tertiaries; helium in the gas
Solar modulation, rigidity-binned ratios of bin-averaged fluxes, and 2D (radial) geometry
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field; no comparison with measured B/C; no propagation code (GALPROP, DRAGON, USINE) run
Claims that the illustrative parameter values describe the Galaxy

capabilities.name: secondary-ratio-derivation
capabilities.scope: SymPy checks of the weighted-slab and thin-disc closed forms, their equivalence through lambda_esc = n_H m_H h v L / D, the D0/L invariance, and the finite-disc solution (analytic derivation, not formal proof)

capabilities.name: secondary-ratio-benchmark
capabilities.scope: closed forms against the profile's own numerical solutions on ILLUSTRATIVE inputs: slab ODE + path-length average (1e-7), finite-volume vs exact finite disc (1e-6), thin-disc limit as h/L -> 0

capabilities.name: secondary-ratio-prediction
capabilities.scope: B/C at any parameter point and on (D0, L) grids, bin-averaged prediction artifact with a cross-section model alternative; theory-spec and prediction validate, and a theory-spec without degenerate_directions fails with theory.degeneracy_missing
